statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-8458: because of a logic error in its connection reuse checks, libcurl might reuse an existing Negotiate-authenticated connection to a server for a request that is set to use a different Negotiate service name (CURLOPT_SERVICE_NAME or CURLOPT_PROXY_SERVICE_NAME) (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-8458.html). curl lists it as affecting 7.43.0 through 8.20.0 and fixed it in curl 8.21.0. Negotiate (SPNEGO) authentication is only built into libcurl when it is compiled with a GSS-API library (or Windows SSPI), and the DHI Alpine curl package is built without GSS-API. Checked the libcurl shared library in every published DHI curl build for Alpine 3.23, 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, on x86_64 and aarch64: none of them lists a GSS-API or Kerberos library among its NEEDED libraries, none imports any gss_* function, and the feature list compiled into libcurl contains no GSS-API, Kerberos or SPNEGO entry, while it does contain other features such as IPv6, HTTPS-proxy, HSTS and alt-svc. The same search finds GSS-API, Kerberos and SPNEGO, gss_init_sec_context and a libgssapi_krb5.so.2 dependency in the DHI Debian libcurl4t64 library, which is built with GSS-API. So the Negotiate authentication code, and with it the affected connection-reuse check, is not present in any of these builds.
